Revivedx/SavageWindRecomp.name: Breath of the Wild: Savage Wind

setup.requires: Your own BotW game data, version 1.8.2, dumped from your Switch
guide: Dump your own copy of Breath of the Wild (v1.8.2) from your Switch.
Select the game data folder below.
The launcher runs the project's configuration tool to prepare the game. This can take a long time on first run.
